data.name: Balabhadra
data.gender_notes: Balabhadra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Balabhadra is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'bringer of happiness, powerful, and auspicious'. This name is associated with Lord Balarama, who is an avatar of Lord Vishnu and the elder brother of Lord Krishna in Hindu mythology. The name Balabhadra carries the meaning “Powerful, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balabhadra usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Balabhadra belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balabhadra total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: In Hindu society, Balabhadra holds a significant place in the annals of Krishna-centered mythology. As the elder brother and confidant of Lord Krishna, Balarama represents the virtues of strength, leadership, and righteousness. He is believed to be a symbol of fraternal love and is often depicted as a protector and supporter of his younger brother. During the famous Raslila dance of Lord Krishna, Balarama is seen dancing with his sister Subhadra, which underscores the beautiful and profound bond of sibling love.
data.spiritual_significance: Balabhadra's name symbolizes auspiciousness and the power to bring happiness, making him an embodiment of divine blessings. In spiritual practice, his name is chanted to seek his grace and blessings for overall wellbeing, prosperity, and good health. Balarama is also considered a master of the mighty Pāśa (Rope) weapon, which represents control over material desires and attachment. Chanting Balabhadra's name can help cultivate the qualities of strength, detachment, and a deeper connection to the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Balabhadra is a name revered in Hinduism, symbolizing strength (Bal) and auspiciousness (Bhadra). It is believed that the one bearing this name is protected from all evils and is blessed with good fortune.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Balabhadra is an avatar of Lord Vishnu, mentioned in the Mahabharata. The name Balabhadra carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
